text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"It's such a bummer that C.B. won't be at the Takarazuka Kinen either~
Word is her comeback is soon, though..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace and the others have been doing great lately, sure,
but that just makes me want to see
how she'd stack up against C.B. even more.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf is seriously insane~!!
Undefeated Double Crown, that's even crazier than CB!!
If she actually takes the Triple Crown with this...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
She's incredible, isn't she...!
Can't she already compete on equal footing with the Senior Class?
Honestly, there's even a chance Rudolf might actually be stronger.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Alright.
Guess it's about time to get going.

As Katsuragi Ace prepared for her upcoming race, there wasn't a trace of unease in her.
A quiet strength radiated from her calm demeanor...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
choice_data_list: ...I was just thinking how reliable you are.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! What are you talking about?
You're plenty dependable yourself, Trainer!

Katsuragi Ace gives my back
two light pats.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ――I'm gonna go settle who's the strongest at middle distance!!

Watching Katsuragi Ace leave the waiting room after saying that,
her back looked remarkably imposing.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Just as expected of the Grand Prix...!
Everyone came in top condition. But still—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...No problem, no matter who the opponent is.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What overwhelming pressure...!
Katsuragi Ace, when did you become like this...?!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Guh...
Even without C.B., this is totally insane—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Win, and settle who's the strongest at medium distance.
Who CB's true rival really is—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'll prove it all to you!!
